title: Food & Drinks
description: Name common foods and drinks and say what you eat or drink.
objectives: Name common foods and drinks and say what you eat or drink.

stages.title: Understand the language
stages.instructions: Read the explanation, examples, common error, and recap.

blocks.text: This lesson prepares you to name common foods and drinks and say what you eat or drink. The central language is food nouns and present simple. It belongs to the practical context of food & café english. Focus first on meaning: decide what information the listener needs. Then choose the subject, verb form, and useful detail. At A1, keep the message short and concrete. One clear sentence is enough before the other person responds. The same language returns in the listening, repeat, speaking, exercises, and guided conversation stages.

Use this question or response to keep the food & drinks exchange moving.

blocks.text: Notice the two models: “I drink water with lunch.” and “We eat rice and vegetables.” They show the pattern in complete communication, not as isolated grammar. Say the model aloud, replace one detail, and check that the new sentence keeps the intended meaning. When the other person asks a follow-up question, answer directly and add a relevant detail. This makes the exchange natural while keeping the language controlled.

blocks.title: Common error
blocks.text: Do not mix the word order or verb form with another pattern. Keep the controlled form for this lesson: food nouns and present simple.
